blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
This is the last lesson of the Logistics track. It is a full day in your delivery life. The day starts at 5 am at the gate. It ends in the evening with the last signed note.

Each delivery is like a chapter. Each day is a new book. We do many small things every day. We check trucks, we count pallets, and we sign invoices.

In this story we review all the grammar from the Confidence level. We use "to be", the Present Simple, "there is" and "there are", prepositions, modals, and the past tense. All of it comes together in one natural story about a normal work day.

items.q: What time does the day start?
items.why: "The day starts at 5 am at the gate."

items.q: The text says each delivery is like…
items.why: "Each delivery is like a chapter. Each day is a new book."

items.q: Which grammar does the lesson review?
options: All the grammar from the Confidence level
items.why: "we review all the grammar from the Confidence level."

items.q: The writer would most likely DISAGREE with…
options: A work day is one big, boring task.
items.why: Inferência: o texto mostra o dia como muitos capítulos e passos, não como uma tarefa única e chata.

items.q: "Each day is a new book" suggests that…
options: the job is always the same
items.why: Inferência: a metáfora do livro novo indica que cada dia traz algo diferente.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Harry contar como é um dia típico dele. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, everyone. Thank you. Today I want to tell you about a normal day for me. It is my routine, and I am proud of it.

I start early. I wake up at 4:30, and I am at the gate at 5 am. First, I check the trucks. There are eight trucks, and I look at each one. There are many pallets in the yard. I count them, and I sign the papers.

My goal is simple. I want every delivery to be on time. Sometimes there is a problem. A truck can be late, or a box can be wrong. When this happens, I talk to my team. We use short radio messages. Short messages save long problems.

I always say "please" and "thank you". Politeness is easy, and it keeps the team strong under pressure. When a delivery is on time, I say it out loud to the whole team. People like to hear good news.

At the end of the day, I write down what went wrong and what fixed it. Then I learn from it. Every day I learn a little more. Confidence is built one clean shift at a time. That is my day. Thank you for listening.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What time is Harry at the gate?
items.why: "I am at the gate at 5 am."

items.q: What is Harry's goal?
options: For every delivery to be on time
items.why: "My goal is simple. I want every delivery to be on time."

items.q: What does Harry do when there is a problem?
options: He talks to his team with short radio messages
items.why: "When this happens, I talk to my team. We use short radio messages."

items.q: Why does Harry say "please" and "thank you"?
options: Because it keeps the team strong
Because the boss asks him to
Because it is a rule with a fine
items.why: Inferência: ele diz que a educação é fácil e mantém o time forte — é uma escolha dele, não uma regra.

items.q: Why does Harry write down what went wrong?
options: So he can blame the team
Because he must show it to a client
So he can learn from it
items.why: Inferência: ele escreve e depois diz "Then I learn from it" — o objetivo é aprender.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Every morning I follow the same routine." A routine is…
options: a set of things you do regularly
items.why: Routine = rotina: as coisas que você faz de forma regular.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Our ___ is to deliver everything on time."
items.why: Goal = meta: aquilo que a equipe quer alcançar.

items.q: "I work with a great team." A team is…
options: a group of people who work together
items.why: Team = time: um grupo de pessoas que trabalha junto.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I am very ___ of my team's work today."
items.why: Proud = orgulhoso: sentir-se bem com um bom resultado.

items.q: "Every day I learn something new." To learn means to…
items.why: Learn = aprender: ganhar conhecimento novo.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The manager has to sign off on the delivery note." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval.

items.q: "I hand over the keys to the next driver." To hand over means to…
items.why: Hand over = passar/entregar algo para outra pessoa.

items.q: "Please check in with me before you leave." To check in means to…
items.why: Check in = dar um retorno, falar com alguém para atualizar.

items.q: "We agreed a plan, and this time we will follow through." To follow through means to…
items.why: Follow through = levar até o fim o que foi combinado.

items.q: "The new drivers are fast; the rest of us must keep up." To keep up means to…
options: stay at the same speed as others
items.why: Keep up = acompanhar, manter o mesmo ritmo dos outros.
